value.rationale: Variance is the canonical second-order invariant for the ball-size distribution already studied via concentration. The formula resolves it for every binary length, identifies the exact root-mean-square fluctuation scale and leading constant, and directly refines understanding of the gap between an Azuma-scale bound and typical fluctuations.
